summary: End-to-end backend + frontend verification of Amount Mismatch & Discrepancy Invoice Detection. Re-ran the full GST regression suite (67 tests, 1 skipped) + the 8 new discrepancy backend tests — ALL PASS. Added 4 additional regression tests (test_discrepancy_extras.py) covering PUT mismatch+reason flow, PUT back-to-match clearing, status filter, and the warehouse sales-entry guard — ALL PASS. Frontend: logged in as admin@k3gas.com, opened /gst-billing, confirmed new 'Discrepancies' tab visible with all 5 summary tiles, status filter, refresh button, and data-row testids. Triggered the New Invoice → discrepancy-reason-dialog flow with mismatched rate (99999) — dialog appeared with all 6 expected testids (expected/actual/diff/input/cancel/confirm), confirm button correctly DISABLED when reason empty and ENABLED once reason typed. Invoice saved as discrepancy, badge appears in Invoices tab. Discrepancies tab shows the new pending row + Approve flow works: review-dialog opens, note saved, status flips to Approved with toast 'Discrepancy approved'. Tiles update live (Total 2 → Pending 1 / Approved 1).
critical_code_review_comments: validate_sale_discrepancy uses substring 'refill' on connection_type — works for 'domestic_refill'/'commercial_refill' but a payload sending plain 'domestic' silently falls through to 'Domestic New Connection' lookup which can mask mismatches. Document the contract or normalise.
PUT /api/gst/invoices clears discrepancy_status to 'corrected' on match — UI/UX-wise consider distinguishing user-edit-corrected vs admin-corrected for audit clarity.
seed_data_creation: Test invoices created during automation are TEST/DISC_ prefixed; fixtures auto-cleanup. Two leftover discrepancy invoices were created during UI test (DISC_FE_Test, DISC_Sales_b819c7) — safe to ignore or manually delete from /gst-billing dashboard.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sales Dashboard discrepancy dialog (/sales → Add Sales Entry) was not directly UI-tested due to time; backend wire-up to that endpoint is fully verified (sales-entries/warehouse/{id}). The 'corrected' status path was covered backend-side only — for completeness, UI 'Correct' button (disc-correct-{id}) end-to-end can be tested in a future iteration.
